stages.name: Bronze Ingestion
stages.description: Raw CFPB database load with native schema reflection and timestamp parsing.

stages.name: Silver Sanitization
stages.description: Whitespace trimming, deduplication on narrative text, and removal of complaints < 50 chars.

stages.name: Gold Feature Store
stages.description: Taxonomy consolidation into 10 balanced business classes (10k ceiling per category).

stages.name: Temporal Splitting
stages.description: Leakage-free temporal cutoff: 70% Train (34.8k), 15% Validation (7.5k), 15% Test (7.5k).

stages.name: Model Zoo Training
stages.description: Baselines, TF-IDF + Logistic Regression/SVM, MiniLM-L6-v2 + LightGBM, and DSPy Prompt Optimization.

stages.name: Statistical Evaluation
stages.description: 1,000 bootstrap resamples, ECE calibration curves, and Holm-Bonferroni hypothesis testing.

stages.name: Fairness Probing
stages.description: Gender, ethnicity, geographic, and typo perturbation flip rate auditing.

stages.name: Complaint Volume Trends
stages.description: Longitudinal monthly volume tracking, MoM growth rates, and 3-month moving averages across products.

stages.name: Model Registry & Export
stages.description: Exporting validated model weights, calibration maps, and real-time inference pipelines.
